name: Rainy Town -Eien no Basho-
source:
Do you remember the promise made in the rain? One small hope may grow into something more...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你还记得雨中许下的约定吗？一个微小的希望，或许会成长为更加珍贵的事物……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
